summary: All eight responses are rejected. The correct answer is 15 inspections (1 from the 'Mixed' envelope to identify its true pure type, then 14 from a second envelope to distinguish pure from 7/13-mixed in worst case). Response_C has the correct answer (15) and valid worst-case strategy but lacks formal lower-bound proof. Response_G correctly identifies the strategy but overcounts to 16. Responses A, B, D, F, H all make fatal one-draw-inference errors or claim forced assignments when multiple remain possible. Response_E gives contradictory final answers. No solution provides both the correct answer with valid upper-bound and lower-bound proofs.
